brief: After-merge bookkeeping without an agent (Lean flow study, mechanisation). nudge.md step 12 has the orchestrator run four mechanical things after every merge: the worktree collector, one #201 comment through tools/pr/gh_comment.py with a byte-identical read-back, the roster stage, and the state docs. merge_pr.sh already runs tools/audit/worktree_gc.sh and merge_train.py runs it after each merge; nothing runs the other three. Make both merge paths finish the job: post the #201 line from a fixed template (pull request, merge sha, group, issues closed by the merge, and the words Leaves #201 open), with the body file under the state directory, since gh_comment.py refuses a shared root; let R10-ROSTER-OPS's roster-sync set the stage; and run tools/audit/seat/state_docs.py once with its push flag. A failure in any of them is printed as OWED and never undoes the merge. Controls: a dry-run fixture prints the exact comment and commands; a refused comment prints OWED and exits non-zero after the merge line; each step's deletion fails a named arm.
